Shop····
The NerdOctaxe power supply is not working. I Tested the oactaxe with the PSU for the NerdQX and its functioning. I plugged the NerdQX with the PSU for the Octaxe and its not working either.
Handed to the team · Dead NerdOctaxe power brick confirmed by cross-test; needs a replacement PSU mai

Hi, I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

That cross-test you ran is exactly the right one, and it settles it: the brick that came with the NerdOctaxe is dead, not the miner. Proof is in your own results:

1. NerdOctaxe runs fine on the NerdQX supply, so the Octaxe board is healthy.
2. NerdQX will not power on with the Octaxe supply, so that supply is failing on a second, known-good unit.

Nothing further to troubleshoot on your side. In the meantime you can keep the Octaxe mining on the NerdQX brick if its rating matches (the Octaxe draws more, so watch that it stays stable and the brick does not get hot), but do not leave both units on one supply.

I have passed my findings to the team with your order number so they can sort a replacement power supply. They are offline over the weekend and pick this up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

If you want a faster read on it, our Discord is very active: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , mention @nullhashrate (JD, our hardware lead).
